content.text:
Seattle received **516** building permit applications in June 2025, counting by application date from June 1 to June 30. Their total reported valuation was about $188.2 million.

This total leaves out 46,262 Seattle permits that have no application date, because there's no way to tell whether any of them were submitted in June 2025. It also covers only building permits. Seattle publishes electrical, mechanical and plumbing permits in a separate dataset, so those aren't included.

FINAL ANSWER: 516
